qa.title: Q&A Technical Test
qa.q1: Explain the difference between a class and an object in C#.
qa.a1: A class is a blueprint or template that defines the properties and methods (behavior) that objects will have. An object is an instance of a class, created in memory, which holds actual data.
qa.q2: What is an interface in C# and what is it used for?
qa.a2: An interface defines a contract containing method and property signatures without implementation. It's used to achieve abstraction, enforce that classes implement specific members, and support multiple inheritance of behavior.
qa.q3: What is Entity Framework and what is its main function?
qa.a3: Entity Framework is an Object-Relational Mapper (ORM) for .NET. Its main function is to allow developers to work with a database using .NET objects, eliminating the need for most data-access code (SQL).
qa.q4: Mention 3 new features of C# 10 or later.
qa.a4: 1. Global using directives. 2. File-scoped namespace declaration. 3. Required members (C# 11) / Primary constructors for non-record classes (C# 12).
